XamlUICommand allows the sharing of the UX associated with a command. In this instance we create a simple Custom Command with a label, icon, shortcut, and description. It's defined as a resource and could be used in many controls, like this AppBarButton. The button (and other controls) automatically gets all these UI properties, without the need to define the properties again.

StandardUICommand allows the sharing of the UX associated with a command. In this instance we are using a StandardUICommand to quickly place the delete command in multiple controls. The StandardUICommand contains the icon, label, keyboard shortcut, and a description.
